title: Moses becomes angry with Eleazar and Ithamar about the sin offering
description: Moses gives instructions to Aaron and his surviving sons about eating the grain offering and the portions of the peace offerings in a holy place. When Moses discovers that the sin offering goat was burned up instead of eaten, he becomes angry with Eleazar and Ithamar. Aaron explains that it would not have been right to eat the sin offering on a day marked by such grief, and Moses accepts the explanation.
